{{Quote|You made sahbiye? I think my friend here has a little crush on you. He never makes sahbiye.|Han Solo to Scarlet Hark after Chewbacca made sahbiye|<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>}}
'''Sahbiye''' was a dish of soft green leaves and meat. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] prepared it once for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Scarlet Hark]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] rarely prepared the dish, according to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Honor Among Thieves" />
